text_block_list.text:
One day, while carrying on with Fine 
Motion's training—
(Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer. Please forgive this sudden 
message. —I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Will you become my family?"

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: Welcome~. How many in your party?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Party of two. ...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You don't need to verify our 
relationship? This is my brother-in-law.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You don't need to verify our 
relationship? This is my sister-in-law.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onii-sama♪ Since we're family, we can 
go inside, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onee-sama♪ Since we're family, we can 
go inside, right?

...I've finally grasped the situation. She 
misunderstands what a 'family restaurant' 
is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I knew it. There's no entry 
requirement for a "family restaurant" 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even though friends go together, isn't it 
weird if it's family-only? And yet, they 
call it a 'family restaurant'......

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought going as a family might grant us 
special hospitality, so I tried it. I 
thought it was a brilliant idea, though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know! To thank you for coming with me, 
I'll treat you to some 'Mystery Juice'âª

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...What was it Groove-san said again? 
Something about kids who press all the 
buttons to play around— Wait, was that not 
allowed? Ah well, whatever♪

...Bracing myself, I absentmindedly 
glanced around the shop, and—

Fine Motion's bodyguards were stationed at 
a nearby seat. It seems even a minor 
outing like this requires protection for 
her.

And on the way back from the family 
restaurant...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! I was able to buy it all by 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Starting from looking for a wallet, to 
learning how to buy things. I've finally 
made it this far...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Grabbing a bite after school feels so 
youthful, doesn't it? Does this mean I'm a 
proper student now?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪

Fine Motion was utterly delighted as she 
snacked on street food. As I watched her 
with a fond smile...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got carried away again. Even though 
my friends just told me not to.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You always laugh at the strangest things, 
Fine-chan"... they said.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is a bad sign of something being 
off. I've gotta be careful! ...is what I 
thought, but then I totally forgot.
choice_data_list:
I mean it's wonderful how you can enjoy 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~, hahaha. Yeah, that's true~. That 
interpretation is the loveliest!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Would you like to go for a short walk 
after we finish eating?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—You know, I'm truly grateful for how 
cherished and well-raised I was.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Back when I spent all my time in the 
castle... My family and the guards were 
always thinking of ways to keep me from 
getting bored.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I love having fun because everyone gave me 
so much of it. All my memories are filled 
with love!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Not once did I ever want to break away 
from there. ...Not even a single time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I do have an older sister who's making 
quite a name for herself in races, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When she said she was leaving the castle 
for the races, she asked me if I wanted to 
come along.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“However, I turned it down back then. 
Because I felt the mission I had to 
fulfill was far more important.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—To become the cornerstone of my 
homeland's prosperity. That is my mission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If necessary for that, I am ready to 
return there right this instant.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're talking about mindset, 
right? If they tell me 'Come home right 
now!', ...I'll try to persuade them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much I want to learn 
about Japan! Seeing the world with my own 
two feet is truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge alone isn't enough to make it 
perfect. You have to touch it, confirm it, 
experience it. Only then do you truly 
understand real fun.
choice_data_list: It's the same with racing, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! You're right! The greatest experience, 
felt with your own legs!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wouldn't have known if I hadn't 
run all out. That it's so much more fun 
than I ever dreamed.
choice_data_list: We'll get to see some lovely scenery too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The view...? Is it different from what we 
can see right now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm already feeling wonderful enough, you 
know?
choice_data_list: It should be even more amazing.

It should be way more incredible than 
this.

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't yet know what it's like in 
top-level races. The view from the 
grandest stage will surely shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I see. My heart can race even more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A beautiful view, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of race I have to run 
to finally reach it.

Her eyes glittered in the evening glow as 
she whispered those words.
